documents.title: Message from Bella Notte
documents.text: Hi Mr. Kim, this is Lucia at Bella Notte restaurant. I'm sorry to tell you that we need to move your reservation for Saturday. A pipe burst in our kitchen this morning and we will be closed until Sunday. We can offer you a table for six on Sunday at 7 p.m., or on Monday at 8 p.m. if your group prefers. Dessert will be free for everyone at the table as an apology. Please reply with your choice by noon tomorrow, or call us at 555-0166.

documents.title: Safety notice for the Aero-X toaster
documents.text:
To: Valued Customers
From: Brightline Appliances

Dear customer,
[A] Brightline Appliances is voluntarily recalling the Aero-X toaster (model AX-200) sold between January and June. [B] In rare cases, the heating element may not switch off, which could cause overheating. No injuries have been reported. [C] If you own this model, please stop using it immediately and visit brightline.example/recall to enter the serial number found on the bottom of the toaster. [D] You will then receive a prepaid shipping label to return the unit. We will send you a replacement or a full refund within ten business days after receiving it. We apologize for the inconvenience.
Customer Care Team

documents.title: Novatec Names New Chief Executive
documents.text: SAN MARTIN (February 5) - Novatec Systems, a maker of software for hospitals, announced Monday that Carla Jimenez will become chief executive officer on April 1. Ms. Jimenez, 47, is currently the company's head of product development and has worked at Novatec for 12 years. She succeeds Robert Hale, who is retiring after 18 years in the position. Under Mr. Hale, Novatec grew from 50 to 900 employees and expanded to seven countries. Analysts welcomed the news, noting that Ms. Jimenez led the development of the company's best-selling patient-scheduling program. However, some investors said they would have preferred an outside candidate with experience in international markets. Novatec's shares rose 2 percent after the announcement.

questions.prompt: What is announced in the article?
questions.explanation: Ms. Jimenez will replace Mr. Hale as chief executive.

questions.explanation: The article says she has worked at the company for 12 years.

questions.explanation: They preferred an outsider with international experience.

questions.explanation: Novatec makes software for hospitals, not schools.

documents.title: Homeline: Returns and Exchanges
documents.text:
Returns: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are unused and in their original packaging. Furniture assembled by the customer cannot be returned for a change of mind.

Damaged or defective items: Report the problem within 14 days of delivery with photos. We will send a replacement at no cost or, if the item is out of stock, issue a full refund including the original shipping fee. Return shipping for damaged items is arranged and paid by Homeline. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after we receive the returned item.

documents.title: Re: Order #55820
documents.text:
To: Adrian Foss
From: Nadia Berg, Customer Care
Date: April 11

Dear Mr. Foss,
I am sorry to hear about the damaged desk. Unfortunately, the standing desk in your color is currently out of stock, and the next shipment is not expected until June. Therefore, we will refund your purchase in full, including the original shipping fee. A courier will pick up the desk from your home on April 15 between 9 a.m. and noon; please keep it in its box if possible. Your refund will appear on your account within five business days after we receive it.
Thank you for your understanding.
Nadia Berg

documents.title: Orientation week
documents.text:
TO: All new hires
FROM: Karen Whitfield, Human Resources
DATE: July 1
SUBJECT: Orientation week

Welcome to Aldrin Logistics! Orientation will take place from Monday, July 8, to Friday, July 12. Attendance at all sessions is mandatory unless you have written permission from your manager. Please arrive at 8:45 a.m. on Monday at the main reception desk to collect your badge. Lunch will be provided on Monday and Friday only; on other days, you may buy lunch at the cafeteria with the voucher included in your welcome packet. The detailed schedule is attached. Business casual attire is appropriate, except on Thursday, when you will visit the warehouse and should wear closed shoes.
